title: Executive E-Commerce Sales & Profit Dashboard
summary: Clean, transform, and model 500,000+ retail sales records into interactive executive dashboards tracking KPI margins, customer retention, and regional performance.
steps: Extract raw transactional CSV datasets and perform cleaning in Excel/Power Query.
Construct a star schema data model linking sales, customers, and geography.
Formulate custom DAX measures for Year-over-Year (YoY) revenue and profit margins.
Design interactive Power BI visuals with drill-down filters and tooltips.
resume_bullets: Engineered an interactive Power BI sales dashboard processing 500k+ records, providing C-level visibility into gross margins.
Standardized automated ETL workflows in Power Query, cutting weekly reporting time by 4 hours.

title: Customer Churn Prediction & Retention Engine
summary: Build an end-to-end predictive machine learning pipeline that forecasts subscriber churn with 88% ROC-AUC and highlights top risk factors using SHAP explainability.
steps: Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) with Seaborn and Pandas on telecom customer telemetry.
Engineer predictive features: tenure bands, payment volatility, and support ticket velocity.
Train and tune Random Forest and XGBoost classifiers using stratified k-fold cross validation.
Deploy feature importance and SHAP summary plots for stakeholder actionability.
resume_bullets: Developed a churn prediction model using Scikit-Learn achieving 0.88 ROC-AUC on 100k telecom customer records.
Identified top 5 churn risk indicators using SHAP values, enabling targeted retention strategies.

title: High-Throughput Microservice API with FastAPI & Redis
summary: Architect an asynchronous RESTful microservice handling user authentication, rate limiting, and cached queries capable of serving 2,500+ requests per second.
steps: Define Pydantic schema validation and SQLAlchemy 2.0 async database models.
Implement OAuth2 JWT bearer token authentication with password hashing (bcrypt).
Integrate Redis caching layer to reduce database reads on hot query endpoints.
Package service into multi-stage Docker container with healthcheck monitoring.
resume_bullets: Built an asynchronous REST API in FastAPI handling 2,500+ req/sec with sub-30ms latency.
Implemented Redis caching layer decreasing PostgreSQL read query loads by 65%.

Integrate PDF text extraction and NLP token parsing for resume ingestion.
Add persistent progress tracking and real-time competency score recalculation.
